timestamp_history.title: v2.16: empty-timestamp backfill. 2,863 chat spans (all gpt-5.2) had empty start_time/end_time from the v2.8 agent.log-based session recovery (smolagents-style logs don't emit per-step timestamps). Backfilled by inheriting the parent invoke_agent's start_time + monotonic millisecond offsets per child — preserves ordering. Closes 242 sessions Lena was failing to build. Regression suite now includes an explicit empty-timestamp check so this can't recur silently.

v2.15: real tool-definition recovery via cross-session lookup. Where v2.14 fell back to {type:function, name:X} stubs, v2.15 now finds the real OpenAI tools-array schemas from sibling sessions in the same (benchmark, harness) and attaches them — full parameter signatures, descriptions, etc. 100% of previously-stub sessions upgraded to real defs. 193,782 chat spans now carry real schemas (up from ~110k pre-v2.14). Smolagents intentionally not touched (its synthesis path doesn't trigger). Lena 0 errors.
